# Digital Product Listing Writer

## Purpose
Create clear product-page copy for a digital download, template, guide, course, or other digital deliverable. All claims must match the actual product.

## Workflow
1. Collect the product contents, format, intended buyer, prerequisites, supported tools, update policy, and known limitations.
2. Identify the buyer's problem and the specific outcome the product can reasonably support.
3. Draft a title, concise summary, detailed description, contents list, requirements, FAQ, and support boundaries.
4. Clearly distinguish included items from examples, previews, bonuses, and future roadmap ideas.
5. Add refund, licensing, privacy, and compatibility wording only when the seller has supplied verified policy details; otherwise flag for review.
6. Check every factual or performance claim against the supplied product evidence.
7. Produce alternative short and long copy, plus a pre-publication checklist.

## Output
Product title, short pitch, full description, contents, prerequisites, FAQ, support boundary, claim-evidence check, and publication checklist.

## Safety and limits
- Never invent product features, testimonials, ratings, scarcity, guarantees, or earnings claims.
- Do not copy competitors' descriptions or protected assets.
- Do not create marketplace accounts, upload products, publish listings, run ads, or process payments.
- No paid tools or APIs. No runtime activation or tool grants.

## Provenance
CEOAI-authored workflow. Copy drafts only.
